claims.assessment: Article presents the certifications as current figures for a 2006 single, and RIAA and BPI thresholds were not met in 2006. Deliberately vague on dates because no award date is given in the source.

distinct_fact_and_source: The Rock and Roll Hall of Fame listing and the 2025 Rolling Stone placing at 96, plus the US and UK platinum certifications. Unused by the other six, and deliberately different from this video's own live creator comment, which already leans on the UK number one. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Welcome_to_the_Black_Parade
uniqueness_assessment: Zero five-word phrases shared with any other package once the song title is set aside. Gate returns five signals, all of them the song title.
uncertainties_and_removed_claims: No award date is given for either certification, so the copy says long after the 2006 release rather than naming a year. Audience retention and geography are not available yet on a one day old upload and nothing is inferred from their absence. Search term dirantai digelangi rindu is unrelated and is not used to justify tags. Current playlist membership and pin state are not asserted.
